_comment: Cargo upgrade levels, in order (the first entry is level 0). The cargo GRID has a fixed slot count (inventory.grid_columns x inventory.grid_rows, 8 x 12); a level multiplies every id's STACK CAP instead: stack_mult x cargo_cap (data/ores.json) for ores, x stack_cap (data/items.json, default 10) for items. Uranium: 10 / 20 / 40 / 60 per slot. Older files without stack_mult fall back to resource_mult, then capacity_mult. Phase 5 crafting raises the level (gameplay::IInventory::setLevel).
